claude.sample_unit: articles (prostate cancer abstracts summarized per prompt)

links.outcome: Readability (FKRE) of AI lay summaries with reading-level-targeted extended prompt vs simple prompt
links.effect: Extended prompt raised median FKRE from 29.1 to 40.9 (p<0.001); FKRE<30 in 11.3% vs 52.5%; grade level 12.8 vs 14.8; insufficient summaries 13.8% vs 52.5%.
links.quote: Compared to the ChatGPT-4 simple prompt, the FKRE scores were significantly higher for the lay summaries generated with the extended ChatGPT-4 prompt (40.9 vs. 29.1; p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated plain-language summaries relative to lay comprehension
links.effect: Even with the extended prompt, median FKGL was 12.8 and reading age 19.5 years, above the ~12-year reading age recommended; the simple prompt gave FKGL 14.8 and reading age 21.5.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering with readability targets (6th grade level) for LLM lay summary generation

openai.sample_unit: articles (two generated lay summaries per article)

links.effect: Extended prompt FKRE median 40.9 vs. 29.1 and met all quality thresholds 86.2% vs. 47.5%, both p < 0.001.
links.quote: Specifically, the extended prompt achieved superior FKRE scores (median: 40.9 vs. 29.1, p < 0.001) and was more likely to produce summaries that met all quality thresholds, including readability and content alignment (86.2% vs. 47.5%, p < 0.001).

links.effect: 78 (97.5%) simple-prompt and 77 (96.3%) extended-prompt summaries achieved comprehensiveness score ≥4.
links.quote: A total of 78 (97.5%) simple-prompt lay summaries and 77 (96.3%) extended-prompt lay summaries achieved sufficiently high comprehensiveness, defined as a comprehensiveness score ≥ 4.

unlisted_practices: Use an extended ChatGPT-4 prompt specifying readability targets and a 6th-grade reading level for lay summaries.

links.outcome: Readability and grade level of generated lay summaries
links.effect: Median FKRE was 29.1 for simple prompt vs 40.9 for extended prompt (p < 0.001); FKRE < 30 in 52.5% vs 11.3%; median grade level was 14.8 vs 12.8.
links.quote: Compared to the ChatGPT-4 simple prompt, the FKRE scores were significantly higher for the lay summaries generated with the extended ChatGPT-4 prompt (40.9 vs. 29.1; p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering with explicit readability targets and grade-level constraints to improve lay summary readability
